smyx-race-foul-detection-analysis 1.0.0 — Initial release for pet race foul detection via video analysis.

- Triggers on start/finish track video upload or URL for pet races (dog, horse, etc.), analyzing for false starts and lane crossing.
- Extracts each participant’s start time, finish order, lane assignment, and outputs structured verdicts without providing race advice.
- Enforces strict open-id (user identity) collection process before any analysis or report listing.
- Supports both video upload and network URLs for analysis using a dedicated Python script and API.
- Includes automatic detection and Markdown-formatted listing of historical foul reports upon certain keywords.
